problem.unknownService: That verification service isn't in the catalog.

problem.alreadyConnected.message: {service} is already connected in this workspace. Replace its key on its page.

problem.keyRejected.message: {service} rejected this key ({status}). Copy it again from the API page of your {service} account, or create a new one there.
problem.keyRejected.note: status: the HTTP status the service answered, such as 401

problem.noCreditsKey: The key works, but {service} has no credits left. Add credits in {service}, then try again.
problem.unreachable: {service} didn't answer, so nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
problem.noService: No verification service is connected. Connect one in Settings › Integrations.

problem.noServiceAsk.message: No verification service is connected. {helpers} can connect one in Settings › Integrations.
problem.noServiceAsk.note: helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.nothingToCheck: There's nothing to check: every address was checked in the last 90 days, or the selection is empty.
problem.jobNotStopped: Only a job that stopped for credits or an outage can be resumed.

problem.formsEdit.message: Your role can't edit forms, so it can't turn real-time checks on or off. Ask {helpers}.
problem.formsEdit.note: helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.formsEditPlain: Your role can't edit forms, so it can't turn real-time checks on or off.
problem.noFormsService: Pick a default service for signup forms first, on its page in Settings › Integrations.
problem.contactErased: This contact was erased, so there's no address to check.

problem.tiers.message: Tiers are active, cooling, at_risk and sunset.
problem.tiers.note: the API's values for tiers, as written

tier.active.note: the engagement tiers of List health

region.unitedStates.note: where a verification service processes addresses

label.tiers.note: what a job checked; tiers: tier names joined as 'A and B'

label.selection.message: {count, plural, one {# selected contact} other {# selected contacts}}
label.selection.note: what a job checked: contacts picked by hand

what.import.note: a service's last use, after its time: what it checked

what.job.note: what: what the job checked (Sunset tier, Product Updates, import preview)

tray.running.message: {kind, select, tier {Verifying the {label} tier with {service}} other {Verifying {label} with {service}}}
tray.running.note: label: what is checked (Sunset, Product Updates); service: ZeroBounce, Kickbox…

tray.done: {kind, select, tier {Verified the {label} tier with {service}} other {Verified {label} with {service}}}
tray.stopped: {kind, select, tier {Verifying the {label} tier stopped} other {Verifying {label} stopped}}
tray.cancelled: {kind, select, tier {Verifying the {label} tier was cancelled} other {Verifying {label} was cancelled}}
tray.stoppedDetail: {checked, number} of {total, number} checked; their results are kept
tray.eta: {minutes, plural, one {# min left} other {# min left}}

notify.jobFinishedTitle.note: label: what was checked (Sunset tier, Product Updates)

notify.jobFinishedSummary: {suppressed, plural, one {# suppressed} other {# suppressed}}, {risky, plural, one {# tagged risky} other {# tagged risky}}. {service} checked {checked, number} addresses.
notify.jobStoppedCredits: {service} has no credits left. Results for {checked, number} of {total, number} are kept. Add credits in {service}, then Resume.
notify.jobStoppedDown: {service} didn't answer for an hour. Results for {checked, number} of {total, number} are kept; check the rest later.
notify.jobStoppedKey: {service} rejected the API key. Results for {checked, number} of {total, number} are kept. Replace the key, then Resume.
notify.creditsLowNeeded: {balance, number} credits left at {service}. Checking {label} needs {needed, number}.
